taskNotes: Lesser demons require 60 combat to be assigned and have no Slayer level requirement.
slayerTargetId 248 is SYNTHETIC (WC-1..11 allocation contract: 240 + WC index); the real SLAYER_TARGET varp value is a QA live-verify item.
Lesser demons are demons, so demonbane weapons such as Emberlight and Arclight apply.
Lesser demons have a 40% elemental weakness to water spells.
Krystilia assignments (80-120) must be completed in the Wilderness: Lava Maze, Demonic Ruins, or the Wilderness Slayer Cave.
The Wilderness Slayer Cave demons are boosted to 110 Hitpoints with enhanced drops but the cave is a player killing hotspot.
Catacombs of Kourend demons use the Catacombs drop table with ancient shards and dark totem pieces.
Zakl'n Gritch, K'ril Tsutsaroth's bodyguard in the God Wars Dungeon, counts as a Lesser demon kill.
Most locations are single-combat, cannonable, and safespottable; the caged demons at the Wizards' Tower, Kourend Castle, and Kingstown are risk-free but slow.
No task extension unlock exists for Lesser demons.
recommendedMethod: Use demonbane melee (Emberlight or Arclight) or a cannon at the Chasm of Fire middle floor for low-attention tasks, or the Catacombs of Kourend for ancient shards and dark totems. Complete Krystilia assignments in the Wilderness Slayer Cave with low-risk gear. Water spells exploit the 40% elemental weakness when safespotting.
